name: LiveyChat
description: Displays live YouTube chat messages in-game, with clickable level IDs.

show-status.name: Show Status
show-status.description: Show the connection status text (Connected, errors, ...).

video-id.name: YouTube Video ID
video-id.description: The video ID of the live stream, or a full YouTube link to it (both work).

chat-id.name: Live Chat ID (optional)
chat-id.description: A raw activeLiveChatId. Overrides Video ID when set.

api-key.name: YouTube Data API Key
api-key.description: A valid API key for the YouTube Data API v3 (required).

position.name: Overlay Position
position.description: Which corner the overlay anchors to.

max-messages.name: Max Messages
max-messages.description: How many recent messages to keep on screen.

poll-interval.name: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll-interval.description: How often to fetch new chat messages.
